description: Land Title Settlement Department  -Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District   - Cad. Map No.  610008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and ownership classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
